tasks.title: Double a column by assign
tasks.statement: Add a doubled column with assign and print it.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2]})
print(df.assign(b=df["a"] * 2)["b"].tolist())

tasks.title: Clamp a range
tasks.statement: Clip the values into 0..10 and print the result.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([-5, 5, 50])
print(s.clip(0, 10).tolist())

tasks.title: Map codes to labels
tasks.statement: Map the letters to their numbers and print the mapped values.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["x", "y"])
print(s.map({"x": 1, "y": 2}).tolist())

tasks.title: A conditional column with where
tasks.statement: Keep the value when it is at least 10, otherwise print "low".
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([5, 10])
print(s.where(s >= 10, "low").tolist())

debug.title: An axis name that does not exist

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1], "b": [2]})
print(df.apply(lambda r: r["a"], axis=1).tolist())

debug.title: Column sums read as row sums

tasks.title: Two largest values

import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"v": [5, 9, 1]})

s = pd.Series([10, 20, 20, 40])

tasks.title: Share of each value

tasks.title: Count gaps per column
tasks.statement: Print the total number of missing values in the frame.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, None], "b": [None, 2]})
print(int(df.isna().sum().sum()))

tasks.solution:

s = pd.Series([None, 2.0, None])
print(s.ffill().bfill().tolist())

tasks.title: Keep the first copy

tasks.title: Count outliers by IQR
tasks.statement: Flag values outside 1.5×IQR and print how many there are.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([10, 11, 12, 13, 100])
q1, q3 = s.quantile(0.25), s.quantile(0.75)
iqr = q3 - q1
print(int(((s < q1 - 1.5 * iqr) | (s > q3 + 1.5 * iqr)).sum()))

tasks.title: Count a pattern match
